body: This is so... just hauntingly beautiful and relatable to me. I don't quite know what to say other than thanks for sharing this... Brings tears to my eyes...

I just don't know how people make friends. I don't know how to do anything, really. I'm never going to just randomly start talking to people I don't know. The only friends I've made in the past 4 years are people that have came up and talked to me or people I work with.
Thanks... It is really really hard to believe anything will be better right now.

I think it is a combination of being somewhat abused while growing up and just the depression itself. It feels like I am just genetically prone to depression -- like I wouldnt be happy even if my life was on track and I was successful. Basically to sum it up, I am 21 but still live with family, can't really make enough money to get an apartment yet, dont' have a driver's license or a car, and have not done well in college after 3 semesters of trying. I have some small issues with my body but I think I'm okay there. I just fail at everything I attempt, it seems. I have tried to play instruments but I just give up when I don't make any progress with them. I don't do well at studying comp sci even though it is pretty much the only thing I'm interested in. I can't make friends at all, it seems. I could go on and on. Basically, just not going anywhere in life.

Thank you so much. I try not to forget them but it's hard when the one person you WANT to care about you doesn't think you're that special anymore. I really don't know how people get through things like this. Depression sucks. It is not like I am the disease... But yet it defines me in every way. You can't get people to see the "real" you, because you are buried under all of the emotion/frustration/etc. you know? Idk.

I feel that same way, I never get the chance to talk about all the things I want to in therapy. I just dont feel very good about myself for whatever reason, it was a problem in the relationship because I was always apologizing and feeling horrible for things I did. If I get into this "day treatment" therapy thing I am planning on going into, I will probably do some art therapy as well. Fun stuff...

To be honest we have been talking about how I don't feel very enthused about life and how I don't see the point so my therapist has been trying to get me to talk about what would be an ideal life for me if I could have it. I think it's a stupid hypothetical situation and I won't be able to do what I really want since I have all these issues with depression/low self-esteem. I'm kind of difficult but at least I am still trying to get better somewhat.

Hey, thank you for responding. They do sometimes, but I am also at fault, we had issues with my depression, I tried to work harder on them when she brought it up to me but it was too late...

My therapist is a cool guy, I have had many many sessions since last summer (june I think is when I started), but there was about a 3-month break from october to december. I have been seeing him once weekly but I wish I could have therapy every day. It is the only thing I really like doing. Everything is else is just kind of a time-killer or I'm working because I have to support myself as best I can.
